ai_summary: **Executive Summary**  Akshar Spintex Limited filed its routine Certificate under Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The attached certificate confirms the regulation is not applicable as all company shares are held in dematerialized form, and no requests for dematerialization or rematerialization were received during the period. This indicates robust electronic share management and no material issues or red flags concerning share transfer activities for the quarter.
